# Pinoy Mobile Mechanic

> Mobile auto repair in San Diego County, California. Pinoy Mobile Mechanic LLC is based in Mira Mesa (92126) and fixes cars at the customer's home or work lot anywhere within 50 miles: San Diego, Poway, Escondido, San Marcos, Carlsbad, Oceanside, Vista, Encinitas, Del Mar, La Mesa, El Cajon, Santee, Chula Vista, National City and nearby.

- Services: hybrid service and repair, brakes, oil changes and fluids, diagnostics (check engine light, electrical, no-start, warning lights), A/C service, starters, alternators, belts, suspension, tune-ups.
- Hours: Monday to Saturday 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM Pacific. Closed Sunday.
- Phone and text: 858-933-7045. Book online: https://calendar.app.google/mxYcWMjDeqJaWwGKA
- Licensed by the California Bureau of Automotive Repair, ARD 315968. Customers get a written quote before any work starts.

## Car repair guides
- [Check Engine Light Flashing? What It Means and What to Do](https://pinoymobilemechanic.com/blog/check-engine-light-flashing/): A flashing check engine light usually means a severe misfire that can ruin the catalytic converter. What it means, the risks and help in San Diego.
- [Brake Pad Replacement Cost in San Diego: What to Expect](https://pinoymobilemechanic.com/blog/brake-pad-replacement-cost-san-diego/): Brake pad replacement averages $150 to $350 per axle, and far more once rotors wear. What changes the price in San Diego and why waiting costs you more.
- [Car Won't Start but Clicks? What It Means and What to Do](https://pinoymobilemechanic.com/blog/car-wont-start-clicking-noise/): Car clicks but won't start? It's one of the top reasons drivers get stranded, and San Diego heat makes it worse. What the clicking means and how to get help.
